vectors.description: Nested HXML follows ordered cwd changes and terminates a repeated-file cycle.
Quoted and escaped arguments retain their value while an unquoted comment suffix is ignored.
Class-path and resource requests resolve from the effective cwd and resource aliases are excluded from paths.
Environment placeholders resolve only through the caller-provided resolver.
A library request preserves its name/version and follows only absolute HXML files returned by the caller resolver.
A missing entry or nested HXML fails closed.
An unresolved environment placeholder fails instead of disappearing from the inventory.
An unterminated quote, escape, or required option value fails at its source.
A discovered input outside all caller-authorized roots is rejected.
HXML and resolved input paths do not traverse a symbolic link below an allowed root.
A thrown resolver error or relative library HXML result is reported as a resolver failure.
Caller-selected HXML file and argument budgets stop expansion deterministically.
Polling alone observes an exact-file edit when no native event is available.
Polling observes matching file creation and removal inside a tree.
Polling observes creation and removal of an included empty directory inside a tree.
A nonmatching file and a matching file below an ignored subtree produce no change.
A change after the baseline and before completed registration is emitted by the mandatory second snapshot.
A native exact-file event refreshes the authoritative snapshot and reports the typed caller cause.
A missing tree is watched through its nearest real parent and becomes active after creation.
An exact or tree input whose path traverses a symbolic link is rejected before registration.
A snapshot exceeding the caller-selected entry budget fails before a session is returned.
A request burst becomes one run with the caller-merged cause.
Requests received during an active run become exactly one serialized follow-up.
A failed run reaches the caller error handler and does not prevent a later request.
Closing during debounce cancels the pending run and future requests are ignored.
Waiting for idle after close resolves immediately instead of leaving an unsettled promise.
A negative or noninteger debounce interval is rejected.
